Skill gem drops: SkillGemChance per normal kill (x3 magic, x8 rare), BossSkillGemChance from an act boss's hoard; OffColourGemShare of them are of another attribute than the class's main one. A skill gem picked up twice gives DuplicateGemXp of its next level's experience.

Gem._XpCapDoc: Round 21b lane E (owner P14: a level 1 gem found in high maps must not insta-level): one kill gives each skill gem at most XpGrantCap of its current level's experience span (GemXpFor(level+1) - GemXpFor(level)), so a gem far behind the hero climbs one level per 25 kills at the most; a gem that keeps pace with the hero never meets the cap. Duplicate pickups (DuplicateGemXp) are not kills and are not capped.
Gem._EarnedDoc_r50: Round 50 lane GEMXP (owner 21 Oct: 'its meaningless to level gems now, If I find a gem in map 10, and I am playing with it for 5 hours, and its lvl 12 for example, then I find a new gem at rupture 65 and its lvl 1, it gets to be the same level as the other gem with almost no effort'). Before: every owned gem gained every kill's experience (bar or not), and a gem found late started two levels under the character's cap (found at hero 68 = gem 17, banked to 18: level 12 for free). Now: FoundGemStartLevel - a gem a player picks up or buys from the Wagon starts at this level (the banked head start stays: at most +2 levels); bXpOnlyInUse - only gems on the skill bar (or the spell a Channel Conduit on the bar casts) gain experience. Kept-pace gems level exactly as before. Sim (scratchpad r50/gemxp/gem_xp_sim.py, 30 kills/min): a new gem at RL 65 reaches 12 in ~2,200 kills (~74 min), RL 80 ~52 min, RL 35 ~176 min. -BOGemXpLegacy = the old rules. Old saves keep every level and its experience.
